mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT RP.PERM_CD as "permCd" ,UR.SYS_CD as "sysCd" FROM TB_USER_ROLE UR JOIN TB_ROLE_PERM RP ON RP.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId}

WITH RECURSIVE A (SYS_CD, P_SYS_CD, DEPTH) AS ( SELECT SYS_CD, P_SYS_CD, 0 FROM TB_SYS_INFO WHERE SYS_CD = #{sysCd} UNION ALL SELECT S.SYS_CD, S.P_SYS_CD, A.DEPTH + 1 FROM TB_SYS_INFO S JOIN A ON S.SYS_CD = A.P_SYS_CD WHERE A.DEPTH < 20 ) SELECT SYS_CD FROM A

SELECT R.ROLE_ID as "roleId" ,R.ROLE_NM as "roleNm" ,R.ROLE_DESC as "roleDesc" ,R.BUILTIN_YN as "builtinYn" ,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UR.USER_ID) FROM TB_USER_ROLE UR WHERE UR.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID) as "userCnt" ,R.UPDT_DT as "updtDt" FROM TB_ROLE R ORDER BY CASE WHEN R.BUILTIN_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, R.ROLE_NM
SELECT PERM_CD FROM TB_ROLE_PERM WHERE ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY PERM_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ROLE (ROLE_ID, ROLE_NM, ROLE_DESC, BUILTIN_YN, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{roleNm}, #{roleDesc}, 'N', #{now}, #{userId}, #{now}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_ROLE WHERE ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND BUILTIN_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT UR.USER_ID as "userId" ,U.NM as "userNm" ,UR.SYS_CD as "sysCd" ,CASE WHEN UR.SYS_CD = '*' THEN NULL ELSE S.SYS_NM END as "sysNm" ,UR.CRET_DT as "cretDt" FROM TB_USER_ROLE UR JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = UR.USER_ID AND (U.DEL_YN = false OR U.DEL_YN IS NULL) LEFT JOIN TB_SYS_INFO S ON S.SYS_CD = UR.SYS_CD WHERE UR.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY UR.USER_ID, UR.SYS_CD

SELECT R.ROLE_ID as "roleId" ,R.ROLE_NM as "roleNm" ,UR.SYS_CD as "sysCd" ,CASE WHEN UR.SYS_CD = '*' THEN NULL ELSE S.SYS_NM END as "sysNm" FROM TB_USER_ROLE UR JOIN TB_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SYS_INFO S ON S.SYS_CD = UR.SYS_CD WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.ROLE_NM, UR.SYS_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER_ROLE (USER_ID, ROLE_ID, SYS_CD, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{sysCd}, #{now}, #{cretUserId}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, ROLE_ID, SYS_CD) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND SYS_CD = #{sysCd}
mapper.select: SELECT M.DM_SYS_CD FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CHANGE_HISTORY H JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL M ON M.DM_ID = H.DM_ID WHERE H.CHANGE_SEQ = CAST(#{changeSeq} AS BIGINT)
